messages:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] prod-eu-west-1 /v1/chat generate 5xx spike > 20% (1m) at 03:12:40 UTC. auto-created incident candidate.
monitoring-bot: Error samples show backend KV timeouts and a surge of concurrent open KV connections.
alice-sre: seeing it too, spike started ~T-90s. UI request queueing + worker OOMs on a couple hosts.
incident-bot: Attempting automated page via PagerService webhook...
incident-bot: FAILED to page: 403 Forbidden from https://pager.example.com/webhook (signature_ver mismatch, header x-pager-version=2). Attempts: 3. Paging suppressed by safety gate.
ben-eng: Wait what, we rotated pager keys last night for the new signer v2 — did we roll the secret to prod?
clara-ops: I pushed the k/v rotation to staging only, thought the prod job would pick it up during maintenance window. Looks like the job errored out due to a permissions change.
dave-sec: Confirmed: new key id "signer-v2" exists in secrets mgr but the CI job lost access to the prod namespace. I'm regranting perms now.
incident-bot: Note: automated incident tracker creation failed: POST to https://tracker.internal/incidents returned 500 (body: {"error":"db_unavailable"}). Manual ticket required if paging stays down.
emma-support: We already have a support ticket from a customer complaining about degraded inference latency (ticket #6249). Putting a note to update them if this impacts SLA.
alice-sre: Paging failing is bad — can we fallback to owner's slack DMs or call list? incident-bot, can you retry to fallback channel: #oncall-manual-escalate?
incident-bot: Fallback channel post attempt -> Slack webhook 200 OK. Message posted to #oncall-manual-escalate. PagerService remains returning 403 for webhook requests.
ben-eng: Manual pinging primary oncall (Alice) and eng lead. @alice-sre please ack.
alice-sre: Ack. I'm on it. Taking lead.
clara-ops: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon affected inference workers and restart to clear KV connection leaks; 2) reduce concurrency for /v1/chat requests at the edge (rate-limit per-IP); 3) increase KV client timeouts to prevent cascading retries.
ben-eng: Rolling restart on 6 hosts now (graceful). Will also flip edge rate-limit to 20rps per-key. ETA 5m.
dave-sec: Prod secret rotation job fixed and re-run. New signer v2 secret pushed to PagerService config endpoint.
incident-bot: PagerService test webhook still returns 403 from signer check for requests signed with signer-v2 from our infra. Detected mismatch: our infra is signing with signer-v1 due to cached secret on 3 deployers.
ben-eng: Those deployers are the ones that failed to pull the new secret when the job errored earlier. For immediate unblock, I'll manually POST the current valid signer header from the console to PagerService to verify.
ben-eng: Quick test curl: ```curl -X POST https://pager.example.com/webhook -H 'X-Signature: v1:abc123' -d '{"msg":"test"}'``` returned 200 from my laptop (we can page from manual client). However infra requests are 403.
alice-sre: So we can page manually for now. Emma, can you coordinate a phone-based escalation to the oncall rotation if we need to reach people?
emma-support: Doing phone escalations now and updating ticket #6249 with a status note.
clara-ops: Restarted and cordoned hosts are coming healthy. Error rate dropping: 5xx from 22% -> 3% in 4 minutes.
incident-bot: Observability note: incident tracker POST still 500; created internal incident stub: INC-8301 (manual).
dave-sec: Follow-up item: ensure secret sync job has proper retry/backoff and SRE notification on failure. Also add a 'paging_health' metric that tracks 4xx/5xx from PagerService.
alice-sre: Agreed. Also add a safety override in incident-bot to auto-post to #oncall-manual-escalate when pager webhook returns >= 2 consecutive auth errors.
emma-support: Customer notification draft in #support-incident-comm. Will send after postmortem copy.
ben-eng: Confirming production is stable for now. I'll finish a rollout to clear cached signer on deployers (rolling restarts of deployer pods).
clara-ops: Marking incident INC-8301 as resolved by alice-sre. Duration ~18m. Root cause summary in thread: combination of deployer secret sync failure + KV client overload leading to cascading 5xx. Paging automation failed because of auth mismatch and lack of fallback gating.
alice-sre: Postmortem owners: alice-sre (lead), dave-sec (security remediations), ben-eng (deploy automation), clara-ops (runbooks). Follow-ups: add paging_health metric, fix tracker auto-create retries, add incident-bot fallback override, add deployer secret pull monitoring.
emma-support: Logged customer impact for ticket #6249 and will link postmortem.
incident-bot: INC-8301 resolved. Tags: "paging-integration", "secret-rotation", "kv-timeouts".
